definitions.short: Shear-Jashub , the symbolic name of one of Isaiah's sons
definitions.full: H7610. Shear Yashub יָשׁוּב שְׁאָר proper name, masculine of Isaiah's son Isa 7:3 ( = a remnant shall return , compare 10:21 ; ᵐ5 ὁ καταλειφθείς Ἰασουβ ).
